title: Descriptive Writing
titleMy: ဖော်ပြချက် စာပိုဒ်
description: Type a descriptive paragraph with rich vocabulary.

exercises.instruction: The sunset turned the sky into a sea of orange and pink. Long shadows stretched across the quiet field. A cool breeze carried the smell of fresh grass while the first little star began to shine.
